electrical_block_run_invariance.interpretation: fixture property only: the synthetic electrical block is identical across runs, so it cannot carry scenario/controller identity

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: applied state observed at or before t
provenance.intended_role: predictive input candidate and applied-state observability
provenance.leakage_or_shortcut_risk: CONTROLLER_ACTION_PROXY: the controller may already have reacted to the same thermal excursion; a classifier can recognize an intervention instead of predicting the event
provenance.missingness_behavior: missing when the applied state is absent
provenance.online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
provenance.origin: POWER_PATH controller applied state as present in the telemetry row
provenance.physical_source_meaning: Cooling state actually driven at the edge, not an ACK and not electrical proof.
provenance.quality_requirement: applied state present at the anchor
provenance.verified_actuation: NO: an applied command is not proof that current flowed

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: duty observed at or before t

provenance.missingness_behavior: missing when duty is absent; a missing duty is never zero
provenance.online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population

provenance.quality_requirement: applied duty present at the anchor
provenance.verified_actuation: NO: duty is an applied setting, not a measured response

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: change observed at or before t

provenance.leakage_or_shortcut_risk: CONTROLLER_ACTION_PROXY: a recent transition is a controller event; the feature is causal at t but not a plant-state measurement
provenance.lookback_rule: since last observed applied change, same boot only
provenance.missingness_behavior: missing when no applied change has been observed in this boot or the current state is absent
provenance.online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: value observed at or before t

provenance.missingness_behavior: missing unless electrical quality is VALID; absent PZEM is not zero

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: counter observed at or before t

provenance.leakage_or_shortcut_risk: RUN_AGE_OR_SCENARIO_IDENTIFIER: a cumulative counter grows with time and can act as a run-age/scenario shortcut; a reset or rollover must never be read as negative consumption
provenance.missingness_behavior: missing unless VALID and not below the previous VALID counter in the same boot

provenance.verified_actuation: NO: an energy register is not a thermal-response proof

provenance.available_at_prediction_time: all power samples from integration start through t
provenance.intended_role: diagnostic energy provenance; predictive candidate only with caution
provenance.leakage_or_shortcut_risk: RUN_AGE_OR_SCENARIO_IDENTIFIER + DOWNSTREAM_RESPONSE: cumulative energy grows with elapsed run time and integrates the controller response
provenance.lookback_rule: since first VALID electrical sample, same boot only
provenance.missingness_behavior: missing when any contributing interval is non-VALID or longer than max_gap_s; never bridged
provenance.online_real_availability: NOT_ESTABLISHED_FOR_PREDICTIVE_USE: zero predictive-eligible real runs and no qualified real electrical development population
provenance.origin: past-only left-rectangle integral of VALID cooling-branch power
provenance.physical_source_meaning: Left-rectangle integral of VALID cooling-branch power since the first VALID electrical sample of the boot.
provenance.quality_requirement: every interval since integration start is VALID with a gap no longer than max_gap_s
provenance.verified_actuation: NO: integrated branch energy is not verified cooling

run_invariance.interpretation: fixture property only: the synthetic electrical block is identical across runs, so it cannot carry scenario/controller identity

fold_identity.grouping_key: run_id + pair_id (one effective group per pair)

hard_boundaries: No promotion of synthetic AP to physical evidence.
No known future-feature or controller-action leakage; causal probes are audited, but model-level shortcut attribution is not established.
No probability wording without real calibration support.
No deep-model implementation without a justified GO.
No modifications to A/C/D code or evidence.
No new infrastructure or model-registry service.
No AGENTS.md, .opencode files or agent-session reports in the repository.

intended_use: offline software-control experiments on the W11 synthetic fixture
future shadow-inference candidate only after all release gates
limitations: trained on a deterministic synthetic fixture; not physical evidence
eight development groups only; 4 correlated grouped folds are not 4 physical experiments
primary horizon and critical target are not frozen
no real calibration population; output is a risk score only
electrical block is run-invariant in the synthetic fixture
operating threshold and warning persistence are not frozen

model_inspection.interpretation_note: split usage is a native model diagnostic, not causal feature importance and not evidence of physical predictive value

prohibited_use: public reliability or early-warning superiority claims
deployment or registration in C's backend

validation_evidence.protocol: W11 grouped CV, 4 folds, seed 42, A3B arm

prediction_vs_diagnosis.track_d_evidence: contract-level applied-state vs branch-power consistency interface and software probes only; no empirical real fault labels or detector accuracy
prediction_vs_diagnosis.track_p_evidence: synthetic grouped A3 on the W11 fixture only; zero predictive-eligible real runs; no real impending-critical labels; no physical claim
